en: Black-and-white postcard showing a river in the foreground with a stone-lined bank, a large light-colored building with many windows on the right (the Upplands museum), and behind it a grand Gothic cathedral with three tall spires (Uppsala Cathedral). Trees surround the buildings, and light clouds fill the sky. Printed caption text appears at the bottom edge, along with publisher information.
